```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Configure rendering and load the report packages.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(knitr)
}))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the completed results and shared report controls.
source("report-setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())
```

SBayesRC uses the declared LD and annotation resources with the package's summary
alignment, imputation, model, and scoring sequence. The phenotype is not used to fit or
filter its weights.

## Variant retention and model counts

```{r}
# Display the SBayesRC counts used to audit summary imputation and scoring.
tableVIEW(
  variantFLOW[method == "sbayesrc", .(
    cohort,
    trait_id,
    prs_name,
    stage,
    variant_count,
    percent_of_source
  )],
  "SBayesRC variant retention and model counts."
)
```

## Method files

```{r}
# Provide SBayesRC summaries, model results, checks, and logs.
fileTABLE(
  "^(sbayesrc|qc/sbayesrc|logs/sbayesrc)",
  "SBayesRC summaries, model results, quality checks, and logs."
)
```
